items.briefing:
Australia's communications regulator ACMA has taken Optus to Federal Court over a Triple Zero outage in September 2025 that prevented people from reaching emergency services — a reminder that even major telcos can face serious failures affecting public safety. Interpol is also running a global system to intercept fraudulent payments before they leave victims' accounts, which may help Australian fraud cases with an international dimension.

As AI tools become more common in Australian workplaces, a new report highlights that many organisations lack proper governance around how AI is used. **Practical tip:** Check whether your organisation has a clear policy on approved AI tools before staff use them for work tasks.

featured.title: ACMA takes Optus to Federal Court over September 2025 Triple Zero outage
featured.quote: ACMA sues Optus over critical 2025 outage affecting emergency services access nationwide.
